intent: Inspect and refactor TelemetrySample without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Context Telemetry Stream Intake. Immutable record TelemetrySample(UUID recordId, String deviceId, MetricType metricType, double value, Instant deviceTimestamp, Instant ingressTimestamp, ValidationStatus validationStatus). Nested enums MetricType{HEART_RATE,POWER,CADENCE,GROUND_CONTACT_TIME,RESPIRATION,SWIM_STROKE,SWIM_PACE} and ValidationStatus{VALID,VALIDATION_FAILED}. Invariants: deviceId non-blank, all other fields non-null; t_device is the ordering authority, t_ingress never used for ordering; a failed sample keeps its payload. recordId identity is deterministic: UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes of deviceId|metricType|deviceTimestamp (static recordIdFor). withStatus returns a copy with the new status.
